line_1.speaker: Nettle
line_1.text: Everything the Vault could not hold. They wrote 'overflow' because the other word would have needed a number after it.

line_2.speaker: Nettle
line_2.text: The fen is full. My husband was assigned to it. I asked which measure he became and I was told the Keeping does not itemise persons.

line_3.speaker: Nettle
line_3.text: I can make most things. The physician down there carried rot and remedy in one jar and stopped labelling which was which. I label mine.

gated.speaker: Nettle
gated.text: You cleared the swamp above us. Same water, younger. It had not learned to lean yet.

start.speaker: Nettle
start.text: Nettle has taken a corner of the tower and made it look lived in, which is more than the tower has managed on its own.

choices.text: I have resin. Make me something against the rot.

nettle_service.speaker: Nettle
nettle_service.text: Two of resin and I can draw the venom out of it. It will not taste of anything you would recognise as medicine.

nettle_arc.speaker: Nettle
nettle_arc.text: I did. She was a fen-wife before I was one and she went down when the Chapter asked for volunteers who understood water. I will not say the name. Saying it is how you get answered.
